description:
## Question

ADR 0001 needs a local cache-only REAPI server (bazel-remote) on every developer machine. Where does its store live (per machine, shared across checkouts: required by the local-hits constraint), what size and eviction, who starts and stops it (tk on demand, a user service, devenv process), how tk makes sure it is up before a cached test runs (a failed connect may stick for the daemon's life), and how tk turns the runner on per invocation without invalidating buck2's build state?
title: How does tk run the local test result cache?
